title: Chart workbooks fail cell reads and can lose charts on preview save
prompt: Open or parse an XLSX containing a column chart created by openpyxl, then attempt a native preview edit/save.

assertions.requiredBehavior: Read cells without modifying the original drawing package. Keep chart-containing previews read-only with an explanation until native saves can preserve charts; support verified chart-preserving updates through chat.

liveAcceptance: Verified in the macOS Electron walkthrough; provider-backed journeys used the connected ChatGPT subscription with GPT-6.1 Sol.
notes: Traceability specification, not an automatically graded eval result. The linked executable tests passed on this independent issue branch; this metadata commit does not change runtime code.
